title: Line of Best Fit
summary: Simple regression with lm(): read summary(), pull out b, its CI and R², predict a new value, and see that the standardised slope is r.
hints: `model <- lm(morale_score ~ sleep_hours, data = sleep)`: outcome on the left of `~`.
`predict(model, newdata = data.frame(sleep_hours = 8))`. Standardised: `lm(scale(morale_score) ~ scale(sleep_hours), data = sleep)`.
